title: Clarence Thomas: World RV Championship - Astra + Fable + Unreal + Blender
author: silvercoated1
selftext:
I really wanted to see how well Astra + Fable workflow handles Unreal so I created this RV rally game for testing. 

Map is generated using map data of Monte Carlo rally (Col de Turini). Full circuit run took me about 25 mins so pretty large map. 

Stacks:   
Astra = project boiler plate, map generation, RV modeling, graphical improvements  
Blender = car modeling  
Meshy = building props  
Fable/Opus = sound, UI, building generation, bug fix  
Grok = images  
Unreal + free tree assets. 

My usage ran out so I guess I will go touch some grass.
